title: sent email does not appear in sent email list
creator: clarke6
content:
Bug report 15 Aug. 2026

The disappearing emails.

It took me a while to find out what was going on. My friend said some of his Sent mail was nowhere to be found. After searching for it in a 'wrong' place it does not exist. Sending to the same recipient and again it just disappears. Simplifying the mail down to just address and the word "test", it still disappears. No combination of a Thunderbird search nor an Everything search finds anything. No return error message from this provider nor the recipients.

This address is for the local electricity board, other mails to other departments 

go through correctly and are found in the Sent email directory.

A careful inspection of the contact information shows this is the only department 

without a "Shown Name" it only has an email address filled in.

Entering a Name for this contact solves the problem, it now shows up in the Sent 

folder and is easily searchable.

I hope this explanation helps some one else with a 'Houdini' email.
